findings.comment: Plans show transformer pads in proximity to buildings but do not provide dimensioned clearance measurements or documentation. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from buildings, nor can compliance with the reduced 3-foot clearance exception requirements (including Austin Energy Design written approval, non-confined space verification, adequate vertical clearances to windows/doors, and 3-hour fire rating documentation) be assessed from available documents.

Plans show three transformer pad locations but do not depict access door orientation or hot-stick use areas. Minimum 10-foot clearance requirement from the access door side of transformer pads cannot be verified from available site plan and electrical plan documents.

Plans do not identify whether transformer locations face confined spaces (niches, vaults, or areas enclosed on 3+ sides) or provide cross-section drawings demonstrating whether 15-foot clearance requirement applies. Compliance cannot be verified from available documents.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations - eastern portion and central areas
findings.comment: Cross-section drawings are not provided showing vertical clearances in access paths to transformer pad locations. No drawings are available demonstrating compliance with overhead structure clearances, parking garage clearances, or enclosed area clearances required by UCM § 1.10.3 survey requirements.

Electrical plans do not specify whether transformers are oil-filled or dry-type equipment. Without this specification, the requirement that grading must direct liquid flow away from buildings cannot be assessed. Grading plan shows drainage generally directed away from buildings at each location, but the oil-filled equipment designation is not documented on the electrical plans.

applicableAreas: East-Central transformer location (between Bldgs. 4-5); Northwest and Southwest transformer locations (west side near Valley View Road boundary)
findings.comment: Site plan does not clearly depict transformer pad locations with sufficient precision to verify they are located entirely outside drainage easements, water easements, sewer easements, or electrical easements. Plat (Sheet 2) shows existing 26' drainage easement, existing 10' wastewater easement, and existing 3' electrical easement. Without AE Design written approval or precise dimensional verification that transformers are outside these easements, compliance cannot be verified.

Transformer easements are not shown around any of the three transformer pads on the site plan or electrical plan. No transformer-specific easement boundaries or width dimensions are depicted on the plans. Proper documentation of transformer easements for Austin Energy accessibility requirements is missing.

Transformer pad dimensions are not specified on the electrical plan or site plan. No references to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are provided. Service type (single-phase or three-phase) is not documented on electrical or site plans. Compliance with AE Design-approved pad dimensions cannot be verified.

Plans do not depict proximity of transformer pads to parking areas or vehicle routes with sufficient dimensioning. Bollard requirements cannot be assessed, and no bollard details or specifications are shown on the plans. Compliance with 4-inch diameter galvanized rigid metal post requirements where pads are within 4 feet of parking/traffic areas cannot be verified.
